maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from paper packaging consumables (Geami, WrapPak, FillPak) used up in shipping, plus some packing equipment; not repair work.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private e-commerce, retail and fulfillment businesses buying paper packaging and packing automation equipment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling paper packaging systems and automation; only occasional acquisitions, such as its automation purchases.

mission_critical.reason: Paper packaging is fairly substitutable, though installed dispensing machines and automation add some switching friction for customers.

notes: Switching cost is moderate because Ranpak places proprietary dispensing machines at customer sites.
